title: Limit on the Returned-Payment Fee by Size of the Returned Payment (Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement)
content:
**Clause.** On a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement the returned-payment fee is limited by the size of the returned payment:

- where the returned amount is **under $100**, the fee is the lesser of the fee level and **25 percent** of the returned amount;
- where the returned amount is **$100 or more but under $250**, the fee is the lesser of the fee level and **20 percent** of the returned amount;
- a returned amount of **$250 or more** leaves the level unlimited.

Each percentage amount is rounded to the cent before the comparison. The returned amount is the amount of the payment reversal on the agreement's ledger, which equals the payment the bank returned; the fee level is the returned-payment fee before this limit.

## Band edges (hypothetical level $40)

| Returned amount | Percentage amount | Fee after the limit |
|---|---|---|
| $60.00 | 25% gives $15.00 | $15.00 |
| $99.99 | 25% gives $25.00 (rounded from $24.9975) | $25.00 |
| $100.00 | 20% gives $20.00 | $20.00 |
| $249.99 | 20% gives $50.00 (rounded from $49.998) | $40.00 |
| $250.00 | not limited | $40.00 |

## Basis question
*A $180.00 payment returned for a closed account, fee level $30?* 20 percent of $180.00 is $36.00; the lesser of $30.00 and $36.00 is $30.00.
